subject: general
question:
Simplify:

(a⁻¹ + b⁻¹) ÷ (a⁻³ + b⁻³)
solution:
**Given:**

(a-1 + b-1) ÷ (a-3 + b-3)

**Concept Used:**

Inverse = (1)/(Original)

**Calculation:**

⇒ (a-1 + b-1) ÷ (a-3 + b-3)

⇒ ((1)/(a)+(1)/(b)) div ((1)/(a³)+(1)/(b³))

⇒ (frac{1)/(a)+(1)/(b)}{(1)/(a³)+(1)/(b³)}=(frac{a+b)/(ab)}{(b³+a³)/(a³b³)}

⇒ ((a+b)times a³b³)/(abtimes(b³+a³))=((a+b)times a³b³)/(abtimes(a+b)(a²+b²-ab))

⇒ (a²b²)/(a²+b²-ab)

**Hence, the simplified value of the expression is (a²b²)/(a²+b²-ab)**
